svg.title: Corporation policy, chargeback, and unit policy
svg.desc: The master policy covers the building as the standard unit defines it. A deductible can be charged to owners. The unit policy carries betterments, loss assessment, contents, and liability.
svg.text: Three layers. The fee only buys the first.
Labelled. Your certificate and by-law control. 24 Sep 2026.
Master policy: common elements and the standard unit.
Chargeback: the corp deductible the by-law can send you.
Betterments, loss assessment, contents, liability, extra living costs.
A reserve special assessment is often not an insured loss assessment.
A previous owner's kitchen above the standard unit is still your limit.
Education only. Not a reading of your declaration.
